hal/fm1_flash.h.reason: Preserves prior interrupt-enable state, accounts for NOR status-poll deadlines, validates caller source spans, stages each program page in aligned SRAM, and now refuses erase/program before IRQ masking unless the live SP lies in an app.ld stack window with 1 KiB headroom, the staged page is fully on that stack, and the timing word is aligned ordinary SRAM. A narrow FL_PROGRAM_PAGE seam lets the host fixture assert the staged page pointer. Intentional local FM-1 changes; upstream source remains identified by revision and original hash.

hal/fm1_sys.h.reason: Adds checked P33 transfers and checked watchdog stop/re-arm helpers. Original bytes are pinned by the initial import and match the upstream inventory; safety-sensitive NOR callers require propagated transfer errors and readback.

src/platform.c.reason: Adds a compile-time guarded native UART1 MIDI initialization hook immediately before TIMER5 starts, preserving unchanged behavior when LUNAR_UART1_MIDI is not defined. Configuration and identity macros are renamed from FELUCCA_* to LUNAR_*. Adds compile-gated nesting-aware IRQ occupancy hooks around ALNK0, TIMER5, input, USB and UAC service. Short accounting mutations preserve the full prior ICFG; disabled hooks are no-ops and service cadence is unchanged.

src/usb.c.reason: Replaces inherited USB manufacturer and application/update product string descriptors with Lunar Modulator identity, preserving USB protocol fields and required source attribution. Interface configuration macros use LUNAR_* names.

src/bootguard.h.reason: Renames the local header guard from FELUCCA_BOOTGUARD_H to LUNAR_BOOTGUARD_H; code behavior is unchanged.

src/gfx.c.reason: Uses the locally renamed lunar_font header/type; generated font bytes are unchanged.

src/ota.c.reason: Renames local OTA configuration and identity macros to LUNAR_*; preserves the legacy FELUCCA-LOADER-1 wire signature byte-for-byte for compatibility.

gen/lunar_font.h.reason: Renames generated header, include guard and font type to lunar_font; generated font data is unchanged.
